ta_read.text: SPY's daily swings show mixed swings (a range); the last structure break was down on Nov 5, when it closed below $750.36. On weekly bars it is in a sideways (between its 10- and 40-week averages), and the weekly swings show higher highs and higher lows.

The nearest support zone is $745.75–$750.55, where price turned 5 times, most recently on Oct 30, a former resistance that flipped to support; the nearest resistance zone is $752.87–$758.79, where price turned 6 times, most recently on Oct 23, a former support that flipped to resistance.
Over the last 25 sessions there were 7 distribution days (down on rising volume) and 2 accumulation days (up on rising volume); the last move (+2.4%) came on light volume.
RSI is 46 (neutral), with a bearish divergence on Nov 4: price made a higher high but RSI made a lower one: momentum is not confirming the rise; MACD is below its signal line since Oct 15.
A daily close above $758.79 would clear the nearest resistance and confirm strength; a close below $745.75 would break the nearest support and confirm weakness. Direction is not predicted.
